title: Welcome to Tinker & Create
description:
This pack is about two things: building tools that grow with you, and building machines that do your work for you.

There is no wrong order. Each chapter below is a short guided line -- follow whichever appeals to you.

[Tinkers: forge a tool that levels up](quest:questlog:tinkers/first_tool)
[Create: your first automated line](quest:questlog:create/wheel)
[Carrying Capacity: stop running out of space](quest:questlog:carry/backpack)
[Time & Growth: skip the waiting](quest:questlog:time/tiab)
[Exploration: find the good stuff](quest:questlog:explore/compass)

Press ` (grave) or the book button in your inventory to reopen this log at any time.
description_completed: You know where the log lives. Everything else is optional -- go build something.
